Schedule A/B pages are the filer's own re-creation of the county grid (own Candidate/Sheila Srivastava/10/28/2024 header block; 'Page 1 of 3'/'Page 1 of 2' footers) - county-form-recreated layout confirmed, classified county-grid. 'Seven days before a general election' interim box checked; not an amendment; signed 10/29/24 (cover date; schedule headers print 10/28/2024). Office Sought 'County Treasurer', District Number 'County'. Address column bar-redacted across all schedule rows; occupation survives.
